_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Block C, exposure session 1 (AMENDMENT_9 §5): the high-exposure tables whose rows the internet repeats — МКБ-10 v2, ОКВЭД 2, the Kaggle course files cardio_train and Alice, the 2022 release of the Moscow metro stations — with iris as the in-session anchor. Header and row completion on the published bytes, completion prompting, reference protocol, the same seed for both models of the pair. Priced at 6.0 h per model by src/price_plan.py (the C1 estimate of 7.1 h ran in 7.4 h), inside the 10-hour ceiling with the two-hour reserve.
attached_input: all nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached to the session as one Kaggle dataset and picked up from /kaggle/input by file name; the hash check applies to each. Two of them (the Moscow releases, the Kaggle competition file) cannot be re-fetched at all; the St Petersburg portal refuses foreign connections, so its four files are attached as well rather than fetched

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: base model; 1416 calls, 6.0 h by the conservative estimate of src/price_plan.py
its Russian adaptation, same cells, same seed; both run at once, one per accelerator
